تمتثلي (form VIII)
# تَمْتَثِلِي (tamtaṯilī) /tam.ta.θi.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
# تُمْتَثَلِي (tumtaṯalī) /tum.ta.θa.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
